pathsRelativeTo: repo root (the folder that contains index.html)

conventions.strips: horizontal; frame i at x = i*frameWidth, y = 0 (unless "grid" is given)
conventions.origin: Phaser setOrigin(x, y) fractions of one frame
conventions.zombies: 64x64 (brute 96x96, slime split / sprinter blasted_back+tumble 96x64), origin (0.5, 1.0) feet, facing east
conventions.bosses: 128x128, origin (0.5, 1.0), facing east; skill FX attach offsets are px from the boss origin, y up negative
conventions.hero: 92x92, origin (0.5, 76/92 = 0.8261) feet at y=76, facing west unless key ends in -walk-east/-north/-south
conventions.fx: origin per key; hero FX point west, boss FX east
conventions.loop: loop=true: whole strip repeats. loopFrom/loopTo (inclusive, 0-based): play [0,loopFrom) once, repeat [loopFrom..loopTo] while sustained, then (loopTo..end] once
conventions.backgrounds: 1280x720, origin (0,0), top-left at world (832, 0) = fixed camera scrollX; depths far 3, fire 3.5, ground 4, mid 5, lamp 6

groups.title: Player Girl (hero)
groups.description: Chibi girl hero with red cap and backpack; base moves plus six weapons (water, bubble, lightning crossbow, frost, flame, sling). Faces WEST unless the key ends in -walk-east/-north/-south.

groups.title: Player Girl — weapon FX
groups.description: Procedural pixel FX for the hero weapons: muzzles, projectiles, beams/streams (tileable), impacts and status overlays (wet, dizzy, paralyze, bubble trap, frost shatter). Directional FX point WEST (toward the zombies).

groups.title: Player Girl — weapon icons
groups.description: 32x32 weapon icons for HUD / shop (single images, load with this.load.image).

groups.title: Giant Mutant Brute
groups.description: Large 96x96 mini-boss zombie with heavy hurt, part break, blast-back and defeat strips.

groups.title: Comedic Loot Dropper (Clown)
groups.description: Loot zombie: hurt_loot drops coins/gems, loot_explode bursts on death and ends on the loot-pile pickup (see pickups/clown-loot).

groups.title: Cyborg Scientist Zombie
groups.description: Half-machine zombie: spark hurt, fall, and self-destruct explode strips.

groups.title: Bloated Toxic Exploder
groups.description: Self-destructing zombie. `zombie-exploder-explode` is the body animation; spawn the shared fx `zombie-exploder-blast` (assets/library/fx) at the body for the chain-reaction blast.

groups.title: Office Worker Zombie
groups.description: Monster 01. Baseline shambling salaryman zombie: walk/run, attack/bite loops, two deaths, hurt and elemental hit reactions.

groups.title: Heavy Armored Riot Zombie (armored)
groups.description: Armored phase with shield: hurt_armor, shield_break (loses shield), armor_break (loses helmet/plates), then switch to the riot-bare group.

groups.title: Riot Zombie (bare, after armor break)
groups.description: Unarmored phase after `zombie-riot-armor_break`, incl. dismantled_defeat death.

groups.title: Splitting Slime Zombie
groups.description: Splits on death: `zombie-slime-split` (96x64) ends as two mini slimes; spawn two slime-mini at spawnOffsetsX.

groups.title: Mini Slime (split child)
groups.description: Child slime spawned by zombie-slime-split. 64x64 canvas, smaller body.

groups.title: Fast Runner (high knockback)
groups.description: Fast zombie that gets launched: blasted_back + tumble (96x64, translate x in code) then comedic_ko (loops frames 4-7).

groups.title: Trash Can Armor Zombie (armored)
groups.description: Armored phase: zombie wearing a trash can. Absorbs hits (hurt_armor); `zombie-trashcan-break` knocks the can off, then switch to the trashcan-bare group. No death strips in this phase (die as trashcan-bare).

groups.title: Trash Can Zombie (bare, after break)
groups.description: Unarmored phase after `zombie-trashcan-break`: full move set plus a panic run.

groups.title: The Molten Giant, Balon
groups.description: Lava boss (128x128). Skills: lava_slam (fx-slam at impact), volcanic_breath (sustained start/loop/end + fx-breath attached at the mouth), meteor_storm (spawn fx-meteor + fx-meteor-impact during castFrames).

groups.title: The Molten Giant, Balon — skill FX
groups.titleZh: 熔岩巨魔・巴倫 技能特效
groups.description: Skill FX strips for The Molten Giant, Balon. Origins and attach offsets are per key (see anchors/timing); offsets are in px relative to the boss origin (bottom-centre), east-facing; mirror x if the boss is flipped.

groups.title: The Cyber-Steel Behemoth, Balam
groups.description: Steel boss (128x128). Skills: ground_smash (fx-smash at impactPoint), bio_acid_spit (sustained loop 7-10 + fx-acid on mouthAnchors, fx-acid-pool on the ground), steel_whirlwind (loop 3-8 with fx-whirlwind front + back layers).

groups.title: The Cyber-Steel Behemoth, Balam — skill FX
groups.titleZh: 鋼鐵巨獸・巴拉姆 技能特效
groups.description: Skill FX strips for The Cyber-Steel Behemoth, Balam. Origins and attach offsets are per key (see anchors/timing); offsets are in px relative to the boss origin (bottom-centre), east-facing; mirror x if the boss is flipped.

groups.title: Exploder Toxic Blast
groups.description: Standalone 160x160 toxic explosion, origin centre (0.5,0.5). Spawn where zombie-exploder dies / explodes; reusable for any chain-reaction or bomb.

groups.title: Clown Loot Pickups
groups.description: 16x16 spinning coin and three gems (origin centre) plus a 64x32 loot pile (origin bottom-centre, = last frame of zombie-clown-loot_explode).

groups.title: Campus Battle Background
groups.description: 1280x720 campus background (authored 640x360, 2x nearest). Variants A (road, dusk, best), B (yard, dusk), C (night A). Layered far/ground/mid + animated fire and lamp glow. Top-left goes at world (832, 0) = the fixed camera scrollX.

groups.title: Chibi Zombie Concept Drafts
groups.description: 20 front-view 256x256 concept images (PixelLab create_image_pixen). Concept art only — NOT game-ready sprites (no animation, wrong facing). Use as design reference.

Office Worker Zombie / 上班族丧尸: Pale-green salaryman in a torn white shirt, loose red tie and gray slacks, arms reaching forward.
Nurse Zombie / 护士丧尸: Ghoulish nurse in a blood-splattered white uniform and cap holding a giant syringe.
Football Player Zombie / 橄榄球丧尸: Hulking linebacker in a cracked helmet and shoulder pads clutching a football.
Chef Zombie / 厨师丧尸: Undead cook in a tall toque and stained apron brandishing a meat cleaver.
Construction Worker Zombie / 工地丧尸: Hard-hat laborer in a hi-vis orange vest dragging a wrench.
Schoolgirl Zombie / 女学生丧尸: Sailor-uniform student with pigtails, torn skirt and a dangling school bag.
Bloated Zombie / 胖肿丧尸: Round, swollen blob of a zombie bursting out of a tiny tank top.
Skinny Ghoul / 瘦骨丧尸: Bone-thin, hunched ghoul in rags with long claws and visible ribs.
Cheerleader Zombie / 啦啦队丧尸: Undead cheerleader with a high ponytail, pleated skirt and tattered pom-poms.
Firefighter Zombie / 消防员丧尸: Soot-covered firefighter in tan bunker gear and red helmet carrying an axe.
Police Officer Zombie / 警察丧尸: Zombified cop in a navy uniform and peaked cap with a dangling baton.
Jiangshi Hopper / 清朝僵尸: Classic Chinese hopping vampire in Qing robes and hat with a yellow talisman on the forehead, arms stretched forward.
Mummy Zombie / 木乃伊丧尸: Bandage-wrapped mummy with one glowing eye peeking out and loose trailing wraps.
Punk Zombie / 朋克丧尸: Leather-jacket punk with a tall magenta mohawk, spikes and ripped jeans.
Grandma Zombie / 卷发奶奶丧尸: Hunched granny in pink hair curlers, floral nightgown and fuzzy slippers.
Hoodie Kid Zombie / 小熊卫衣童尸: Small child in an oversized yellow hoodie dragging a torn teddy bear.
Toxic Zombie / 剧毒丧尸: Radioactive zombie glowing neon green, dripping ooze from a ruptured hazmat suit.
Riot Armor Zombie / 防暴丧尸: Armored riot-police zombie with a cracked visor helmet and a large shield.
Clown Zombie / 小丑丧尸: Creepy circus clown with rainbow afro, red nose and a polka-dot suit.
Brute Boss Zombie / 巨兽丧尸王: Massive muscular boss zombie with a huge chest, broken shackles and stitched scars.
